coverage.notes: The official undergraduate catalogue lists 32 course entries (checked in full on 2026-10-20), predominantly distinct honours degrees in English. This is a selective catalogue pack with four representative flagships across the three published faculties, NOT an exhaustive programme enumeration. The catalogued title does not by itself guarantee an unchanged September 2027 offering. Study-model routes (4+0, 2+2) are not counted as extra degrees. The official navigation also advertises a new School of Health and Life Sciences distinct from its three named faculties; any new 2027 degrees there need rechecking.

institution.summary: English-medium university in Ningbo, China, offering University of Nottingham UK bachelor degrees across three faculties.

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Finance, Accounting and Management
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science with Honours (BSc Hons)
programmes.about: Study financial reporting, business finance, accounting and organisational decision-making through quantitative analysis and professional contexts.
programmes.overview: The curriculum combines financial accounting, business finance and economics with quantitative and management study. Students analyse financial information, consider business decision-making and develop mathematical and statistical skills relevant to firms and markets. The course is linked to professional accounting bodies and the CFA Institute University Affiliation Programme, with potential exemptions from selected professional assessments subject to their rules. It prepares graduates for related employment or further study in finance and management.

programmes.name: BEng (Hons) Aerospace Engineering
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours (BEng Hons)
programmes.about: Study how aircraft are designed, built, powered and controlled, combining aeronautics with engineering analysis, laboratories and regulation.
programmes.overview: Aerospace Engineering applies mathematics and engineering science to the design, construction, performance and control of aircraft. The programme develops understanding of propulsion, flight mechanics, structures, safety and airworthiness, alongside practical laboratory work and problem-solving in teams. Its course information also describes management and aviation regulation as parts of professional preparation. Students may follow a wholly Ningbo route or an advertised 2+2 route involving the final two years in the UK, subject to relevant arrangements.

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science with Honours (BSc Hons)
programmes.about: Build a computer science foundation while investigating machine learning, intelligent agents, vision and other artificial intelligence methods.
programmes.overview: This degree combines core computer science, including technical and laboratory study, with specialist artificial intelligence topics. The university identifies machine learning, neural networks, computer vision, expert systems, intelligent agents and heuristic optimisation within its curriculum. Optional robotics modules allow students to experiment with mobile robots in individual and group projects. The programme also offers a Ningbo route or a 2+2 route with later study in the UK, with course options subject to confirmation.

programmes.name: BA (Hons) International Studies
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Arts with Honours (BA Hons)
programmes.about: Examine modern international affairs through history, politics, regional studies and comparative cultural perspectives.
programmes.overview: International Studies explores historical and contemporary societies, cultures and political systems, with particular attention to Europe, North America and Asia. Learning combines lectures with interactive seminars and independent research. Students consider international issues, political developments and relationships between regions while practising argumentation, analysis and communication. In the final stage, students undertake an individual dissertation with guided research. The course supports further study and internationally oriented work.

faculties.name: Nottingham University Business School China
faculties.guidance: Offers undergraduate business degrees including finance, accounting, management and international business. The international applicant entry route is administered through UNNC; confirm programme-specific IB Higher Level subjects and grades directly before applying.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.guidance: Offers first-degree engineering, computing, mathematical and other science programmes, including advertised 2+2 and Ningbo-only routes for some degrees. Review course-level prerequisites and English conditions; direct overseas admission is through UNNC.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.guidance: Offers first degrees in international studies, communications, economics and English-related fields. Some English BA degrees have a higher published language-test threshold; overseas application requirements are set centrally.
